Q.2    In a binary-coded Genetic Algorithm, a 6-bit binary chromosome represents a real
           variable 𝑥 in the range 1 ≤𝑥≤16. If the real value of a solution is 𝑥= 11, What is
              its decimal decoded value?

         (A) 45

          (B) 42

          (C) 43

         (D) 46

          Explanation: Using linear mapping rule:
                               11 = 1 + (16 −1 𝐷                                             26 −1)
                                       15
                                  10 =   𝐷
                                       63

                       𝐷= 42

          Refer Slide-11 of Lecture 41: Basics of Genetic Algorithms.
